title: Filing-Lag Benefit Percent on Member Appeals to Out-of-Network Plans Paying Second (Insurance Coverage & Claims)
content:
**Benefit percent table — Insurance Coverage & Claims, member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays second.**

The second-plan member appeal's filing benefit percent follows the calendar days from the order's collection date to the claim's filing date. The collection date is the date of service on the patient's order under **Laboratory Test Orders**; the order is the order the appealed claim bills, and the filing date is the date the claim was filed.

| Calendar days from collection date to filing date | Filing benefit percent |
|---|---|
| More than 90 (the far late days) | 85 percent (far late percent) |
| More than 45 (the near late days) but not more than 90 | 95 percent (near late percent) |
| 45 or fewer | 100 percent |

Under the second-plan member appeal, the contested charges are multiplied by the filing benefit percent, divided by one hundred.

## Boundaries

| Days | Percent |
|---|---|
| 91 | 85 |
| 90 | 95 |
| 46 | 95 |
| 45 | 100 |

## Hypothetical example

Collection on 3 March, claim filed on 20 May of the same year: 78 calendar days, more than 45 but not more than 90, so 95 percent. Contested charges of 400.00 USD multiplied by 95, divided by one hundred, give 380.00 USD.
